title: Hireloop: AI Job Copilot
description: An AI job copilot in progress. It turns a resume into a structured profile, ranks jobs from public ATS APIs, and tailors each resume using only facts from that profile. Hybrid retrieval and a LangGraph workflow add human approval, validated LLM outputs, and a faithfulness check that flags unsupported claims.

title: Customer Churn MLOps
description: Churn prediction that goes beyond risk scoring. An XGBoost model with SMOTE on 7,032 telecom customers (0.82 AUC-ROC) explains each prediction with SHAP, and T-learner uplift modeling separates persuadable customers from sure things, lost causes and sleeping dogs, cutting simulated retention spend by 56%. Served through FastAPI with a Streamlit dashboard; experiments tracked in MLflow.

metric.label: lower simulated retention spend with uplift targeting

title: Proactive Academic Intervention System
description: A full-stack ML application that scores 5,000 student records with a hybrid risk model (70% machine learning, 30% rules), reaching 0.887 ROC-AUC, 0.764 F1, and 79.9% recall for at-risk students. Includes six DSA modules and a Flask dashboard deployed on Render.
